[[Hassin's Shell]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] dropped by [[Hassin Softskin]], a [[boss]] who can be found in the [[Plains of Jarin]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 8
:[[Health]] +20

This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Scarabshell Aegis]], [[dye]]d white.
